Likely accepting an alternate OCR pass or MM/DD ambiguity."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","summary":"Last-match within a tier is not always correct when multiple same-tier totals coexist","detail":"For 077 the receipt has 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' earlier and a bold 'TOTAL: 23.25' as the final line. Guidance says GRAND/final total — using LAST tier-4 match actually picks 23.25 (correct), but current script picked 23.26, suggesting candidate ordering or an early-return on a non-last candidate. For 074 the generic 'Total' tier captured 'Total Amt Rounded' producing 702 (OCR corruption), meaning tier-4 fell through past the specific 'Total incl. of GST' line."},{"id":"rc2","summary":"GST/tax-summary cutoff and exclusion lists are too aggressive or too loose","detail":"For 078 ('Grand Total : 92.80'/'Total : 92.80') the pipeline returned null. Likely the summary cutoff (SUMMARY_HEADER_RE) truncated lines before the keyword, or an exclusion pattern (e.g. matching 'Total' adjacent to tax tokens) wrongly skipped the valid line."},{"id":"rc3","summary":"Number regex rejects integer-only amounts and comma-decimal variants","detail":"OCR commonly drops the decimal point on receipts (e.g., '10.00' → '1000', '20,00' instead of '20.00'). Current NUM_RE requires a decimal in several branches, so lines where OCR lost the dot yield None and the extractor falls back incorrectly (contributing to 052/074-type misses in similar runs)."},{"id":"rc4","summary":"Single preprocessing/PSM path with no cross-check for ambiguous digits/dates","detail":"Only one preprocessing variant (grayscale+autocontrast) and one PSM (6) are used. For 034 this yields a plausible but wrong month digit. No multi-pass voting or consistency check between date tokens elsewhere on the receipt (e.g., 'Date: 09/03/2018' vs 'Time' header)."},{"id":"rc5","summary":"Date parsing does not disambiguate DD/MM vs MM/DD using surrounding evidence","detail":"The DATE_PATTERNS list orders DMY before MDY heuristically but accepts whichever first matches. For receipts with ambiguous slashed dates, no sanity check uses year/month ordering clues or repeats of the date elsewhere on the receipt."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Rule for 'last matching line within a tier' is stated but implementation guidance is ambiguous about whether to prefer the FINAL printed total or the FIRST tier-match. Skill should explicitly state: within the highest-priority non-empty tier, take the LAST non-excluded line whose numeric value parses with a decimal; if the final printed line is a bold/standalone 'TOTAL' it must win over earlier 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' lines."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Number regex and normalization only handle `1,234.56` thousands format and `d+\\.d{1,2}`. It does not handle: (a) OCR-dropped decimals ('1000' meaning 10.00) with safe heuristics, (b) European comma-decimal ('20,00'), (c) stray spaces inside numbers ('85. 54', '88 .17'). Needs a documented secondary normalization step with explicit safety rules (only apply integer-as-cents when the keyword line clearly has a monetary token like 'RM' and no decimal number anywhere else on the line)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Summary/exclusion rules are not scoped. The GST/TAX SUMMARY cutoff can swallow the final 'TOTAL' line when the summary header appears above it, and the exclusion list can match 'TOTAL' adjacent to tokens like 'GST' in the SAME phrase (e.g., 'Total RM Including GST'). Skill must document positive carve-outs: never exclude a line whose keyword is in the top-priority tier even if it also mentions GST/TAX, and only apply the summary cutoff when the summary header appears AFTER the first explicit TOTAL/GRAND TOTAL line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Only one preprocessing + PSM pass is used in the batch pipeline, even though the skill documents a multi-pass strategy. For fields that fail (null date or null total) the skill should mandate a documented fallback: rerun with (a) PSM 4, (b) PSM 11, (c) inverted/thresholded variant, and merge candidates per field with a tie-break rule (prefer values that appear multiple times across passes)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction does not implement cross-field consistency checks or a locale hint. For receipts with slashed dates the skill should state: (1) if year is unambiguous (4-digit), day/month pair must be validated (day≤31, month≤12); (2) prefer DMY for MYR/RM receipts (Malaysian), MDY for US-style; (3) if multiple candidate dates exist on the receipt (e.g., 'Date:' and footer 'Print Date:'), require them to agree, else pick the one near the 'Date' keyword."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"The xlsx skill emphasizes formulas but does not call out the specific requirement for OCR-extraction tasks: write `total_amount` as a two-decimal STRING (object dtype), write failures as empty cell (None), and never let pandas infer floats. Cross-reference between image-ocr and xlsx is missing."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Rewrite the 'Critical Rules for Receipt Extraction' section with an explicit ordered algorithm: (1) scan lines; drop lines matching exclusion regex; (2) walk priority tiers top-to-bottom; within the first tier that has any candidate, iterate candidates from LAST to FIRST but SKIP candidates whose parsed numeric value is implausible (e.g., exactly matches a quantity line, is 10x/100x the other totals on the receipt, or appears inside a line also containing 'ITEMS'/'QTY'/'ROUNDING ADJ'); return the first plausible candidate. Add a worked example showing 077-style dual-total receipts and 074-style 'Total Amt Rounded' noise."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand number regex and normalization: accept `d{1,3}(?:[,.\\s]d{3})*[,.]d{2}`, strip currency prefixes (RM, MYR, $), replace a lone comma-decimal with a dot, and tolerate a space before the decimal point ('85. 54'). Add a documented 'integer-as-cents' fallback that only triggers when (a) the matched keyword is in tier 1 or 2, (b) no decimal number exists anywhere on the line, and (c) the integer has 3–5 digits (e.g., 1000→10.00, 2300→23.00). Mark this as HEURISTIC and document when NOT to apply it."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Tighten summary/exclusion rules: never apply the GST/TAX SUMMARY cutoff to tier-1 keywords ('GRAND TOTAL', 'NET TOTAL', 'NETT TOTAL'); never exclude lines whose primary keyword is 'TOTAL RM', 'TOTAL AMOUNT', or 'GRAND TOTAL' even if they also mention 'GST' or 'INCL'. Make exclusions require the exclusion token to be the leading/dominant token on the line, not a modifier."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Mandate a per-field multi-pass fallback: if `extract_total` returns None or `extract_date` returns None on the first (PSM 6 + grayscale/autocontrast) pass, run two additional passes (PSM 4 and PSM 11, each with an upscaled 2x variant for images under 1500px). Aggregate candidates and pick the value that appears in ≥2 passes; if all three disagree, prefer the pass whose candidate line also carries a monetary token (RM/MYR/$)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen date handling: add a step that collects ALL date-like tokens on the receipt, validates each (day/month ranges, year in [1990, current+1]), and when multiple distinct dates exist chooses the one nearest a 'Date' or 'Invoice'/'Receipt' keyword. Document DMY preference for RM-denominated receipts and MDY otherwise. For slash dates where both orderings are valid, prefer DMY unless the first field > 12."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit cross-reference to the xlsx skill: 'When writing results, keep `total_amount` as an object-dtype string with exactly two decimals (`f\"{v:.2f}\"`); write Python None for extraction failures; never let pandas coerce the column to float. Sort rows lexicographically by filename before writing.'"},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Common OCR-induced number corruptions' subsection documenting known failure modes seen on receipts (dropped decimal, '0'↔'O', '1'↔'l'↔'I', '5'↔'S', '8'↔'B', ragged thousands separators) and the mitigations: character-class substitutions only when the resulting token parses as a plausible monetary value and the line is a strong keyword line."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short section 'Writing OCR extraction tables' covering: object dtype for monetary strings, None (not NaN or '') for failures, pre-formatting to two decimals before DataFrame construction, single sheet named exactly as required, lexicographic sort by filename, and no index column."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a Quality Self-Check item: 'For each receipt, verify the chosen total line also contains a currency hint (RM/MYR/$) OR appears as the final printed total line; if neither, re-run the fallback multi-pass before accepting the value.'"}],"confidence":0.62}
